faqs.q: Do you build for both iOS and Android?
faqs.a: Yes. Flutter gives you one codebase for iOS, Android and web, so you pay for one app and get all platforms.
Usually 50% upfront and 50% on delivery. Bigger projects are split into milestones, and you pay as each one is finished.

faqs.q: Will I own the source code?
faqs.a: Yes. When the project is paid, you get the full source code and all rights to it.

faqs.q: Can you publish the app to the stores?
faqs.a: Yes, I handle Play Store and App Store submission using your developer accounts.

faqs.q: Do you work with clients outside Pakistan?
faqs.a: Yes, I work with clients worldwide and communicate in English over email, WhatsApp, Zoom or Google Meet.
